qualification.selection: highest feasible fixed rate; cold chooses smallest feasible epoch period; no candidate values are consulted

policy.scope: Ordinary Movie/Series list JSON reads only; no browser, media, category/unified/action/artwork or wholeapp claim
policy.pacing: Existing API scheduler: closed-loop per-reader period, deterministic alternating endpoint; index offset and identical source/native staggering. No catch-up bursts. Separate functional10 barrier verifies admission.
policy.correctness: Every request matches exact original status/MIME/raw-byte SHA/length and parsed JSON order/types; count4500/results24 for each endpoint, unique names/explicit ordering=name. Fixed fixture across phases and fingerprint before/after.
policy.reset: Stop both backends, clear only owned disposable Redis, inspect finite cgroups, force-recreate one backend. Warm grouped auth/settings caches using the same exact endpoint checks before15s warmup. No metadata/content-cache reset inside measurement.
policy.observer: Unchanged rust-guide-perf observer/cgroup/docker_stats and rust-perf sampler; infrastructure+origin+one backend whole-group CPU and Docker working memory, plus components. Optional processRSS diagnostic is not summed as primary memory.
policy.acceptance: All3 alternating paired trials for each1/10 virtual-reader workload,6pairs/12phases, must pass every budget. Each measured phase also requires late_completed==0. Per-endpoint latency/throughput checks cannot be hidden by aggregate results.
policy.authorization: Source qualification needs fresh parent quiet cue bound to policy/manifest/boot. Freeze source-only pacing before any native resource values. Measurement needs separate fresh parent cue bound to frozen plan; no implicit launch from functional mode.
exclusions: No VOD video playback or provider refresh
No accepted gains until whole predeclared matrix passes
